_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking the CSV against Shopify import rules...

description:
Best for: "will this Shopify CSV import?" or "what is wrong with my product file?". Checks the Shopify import rules: columns, handles, options, duplicate variants, statuses, value types (price, weight, quantity, true/false), image URLs, GTIN check digits and barcodes a spreadsheet mangled.
Returns: blocking findings (Shopify rejects them or imports them wrong) and warnings, up to 200 each, each with row, handle, rule, fix and doc (the rule's source page), plus totals.
Input tips: send csv, the full file text from Shopify admin (Products > Export), header row first, up to 2 MB; a larger file is refused with csv_too_large, split it by rows.
Not for: Merchant Center title and description rules or a store address (use merchant_feed_check), or listing text (use listing_text_audit).

csv.description: The full text of a Shopify product CSV, header row first, such as "Title,URL handle,Description,Vendor,Price,...". Paste the file exported from Shopify admin (Products > Export) as it is. At most 2 MB; split a larger file by rows and repeat the header in each part. Example call: {"csv": "Title,URL handle,Price\nWool Beanie,wool-beanie,24.00"}

name: csv_import_preflight

blocking.description: Problems Shopify rejects or that make the import wrong, at most 200

doc.description: The page that states the rule: Shopify help, GS1 for a GTIN check digit, or Microsoft for spreadsheet notation

fix.description: What to change in the file, in plain words

handle.description: The product's URL handle; empty for a finding about the whole file

row.description: Spreadsheet row, header is row 1; 0 for the whole file

rule.description: Rule id, such as bad-price or missing-required-column

products.description: Products found, one per URL handle

rows.description: Data rows in the file, header not counted

totals.description: Counts before the lists were cut to 200

truncated.description: True when either list had more than 200 findings

warnings.description: Problems that import but probably not as intended, at most 200
